source: Zhu et al. 2010 (source original read in earlier work)
stage: target selection before any target effect or participant data inspected
catalogue: DataCite titles-only search for women and ferritin or iron status. Prioritize established, independently recruited nutrition surveys with official versions and questionnaires. No target study results used.

ordered_candidates.title: Food consumption and iron status survey in two provinces of rural Burkina Faso
Dietary intakes, vitamin A, and iron status of women of childbearing age and children 6-59 months of age from Akwa Ibom state in Nigeria

eligibility: First previously unused study with identifiable adult women in a baseline survey avoiding outcome-based inclusion, paired measured hemoglobin and uncorrected ferritin, a documented scale for each, join/complete-case rule, reuse rights and accessible records in the current permission scope. Nonpregnant subgroup if status recorded or design excludes pregnancy. Use primary survey weights if clearly available; otherwise describe unweighted eligible sample. No choice by sign or magnitude. If neither qualifies, complete the source-side experiment and optionally illustrate with the already exposed US comparator only.
checks_before_freeze: Study design, codebook, file fields, consent/access, missingness/eligibility counts. Do not produce or inspect target concentrations, threshold cells, means, relationships, or paper results.
external_use: Same frozen whole-cohort programs without target outcomes; all comparisons descriptive outside source. No target-informed tuning.
